summary: Frontend E2E tested for Iteration 10. Vehicle Types Manager CRUD, dynamic Tipo dropdown on VehicleFormDialog, dynamic strategy_targets by type name (Auto/Scooter/Altro) persistence, manutenzione reminder days (4th REM row), Manutenzione controls sheet with km chart, OK/KO check flow with km prefill, KO->intervention auto-chain (locked vehicle + prefilled description), intervention attachment upload/view, complete intervention with km field, and monotonic last_km update (85.100 -> 86.000 after intervention complete). Flotta grid + Strategia banner/tabs/plan regression OK. ONE bug: Strategia simulator (Strategia.jsx) has NOT been migrated to dynamic per-type inputs — it still uses hard-coded testids sim-need-auto / sim-need-furgone / sim-need-altro and sends legacy query params need_auto/need_furgone/need_altro to /api/strategy. There is no sim-need-scooter input, so the newly configured Scooter type is not usable in the simulator.

ui_bugs.issue: Simulator inputs are still hard-coded (Auto/Furgone/Altro) rather than generated from /vehicle-types. Missing an input for the 'Scooter' default type. Testids sim-need-auto/sim-need-furgone/sim-need-altro still present (review requested they be dynamic).

integration_issues.issue: Frontend still sends legacy params need_auto/need_furgone/need_altro (see Strategia.jsx load()); review states backend expects needs=<json> keyed by type name. Also 'furgone' is no longer a default vehicle type (defaults are Auto/Scooter/Altro), so that input is dead code.

issues: React console warning: 'A component is changing an uncontrolled input to be controlled' on strategy-target-<Type> inputs — value is undefined when targets[t.name] is missing. Consider defaulting to '' explicitly (targets[t.name] ?? '') is already there but the initial render before settings loads leaves it undefined. Minor.

action_items: Refactor Strategia.jsx simulator to generate per-type inputs dynamically from GET /vehicle-types (data-testid=sim-need-<TypeName>), and send params as needs=<JSON string> mapping type name -> number (matching backend /api/strategy?needs=<json>). Remove hard-coded auto/furgone/altro state keys and testids.
Optionally initialize targets state for each configured type to '' before render to avoid the uncontrolled->controlled React warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Strategia.jsx (line ~53, 59-61, 167-183): fixed { auto, furgone, altro } state and testids contradicts iteration-10 requirement of dynamic inputs from /vehicle-types. Needs refactor.

Manutenzione.jsx is now 540 lines — consider splitting VehicleControlsDialog, CheckDialog, AddInterventionDialog, CompleteInterventionDialog, KmChart, StatsTab into separate files. Threshold approaching 700-line limit.

VehicleTypesManager.jsx: delete has no confirmation and cascade impact on vehicles is not surfaced in UI (vehicles keep the old name string; migration is server-side only). Add a confirm dialog for delete.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all iteration-10 features pass except Strategia simulator dynamic inputs)
